# kard-evolve

> Creatures that evolve, measurably: readers of damaged FallKard seal codes, bred, battled and selected against 192 real vision-model misreads, graded by rules on held-out cards, sealed before the first generation, and re-runnable to the byte.

## The result

<!-- ⟦RESULTS-BEGIN⟧ generated by tools/make-page.mjs — do not edit here -->
**The sealed run: 5 of 5 rules held.** After 150 generations of 48 creatures, the champion reads U as V; accepts up to 5 edits when no other card is within 1 more, with at most 5 unreadable (`UV|515`). On the held-out cards it resolves 352 of 352 with 0 wrong; generation 0's best resolves 244.

Nothing told it to look. Along the champion’s own line, the fold on U was re-aimed U → 7, then U → C, then U → R, then U → V, reaching U → V in generation 14. It then swept the population: half of the 48 creatures carried it by generation 18, all of them by generation 21. Every held-out card was already being found by generation 7 (by reading U as anything and accepting more corrections); what selection bought after that was sureness, because U → V saves a correction on every V the model reads as U.

| Sealed rule | Result | | Predicted |
|---|---|---|---|
| on the held-out cards (real and damaged reads), the champion's fitness is higher than generation 0's best | 34462 vs 23908 | PASS | pass — generation 0 refuses every U read and every read past 3 slips |
| the champion carries the fold U → V — found by mutation and selection, never told | reads U as V; accepts up to 5 edits when no other card is within 1 more, with at most 5 unreadable | PASS | pass — the pilot aimed U at W by generation 13; here the measured slips make V the right aim |
| the champion names no wrong card on the held-out reads | 0 wrong of 352 | PASS | pass |
| on the 96 held-out REAL model replies alone, the champion resolves more cards than the spec's own reader, and none wrong | 96 vs 94 of 96, 0 wrong | PASS | pass — the 2 held-out real U reads come back |
| re-running the evolution from this seal gives a byte-identical record — CI re-runs it on every push | CI re-runs it on every push; the page re-runs it in the browser | PASS | pass |

| Held-out reads | Generation 0's best | Champion |
|---|---|---|
| the 96 real model replies | 94 right, 0 wrong, 2 refused | 96 right, 0 wrong, 0 refused |
| the 256 damaged copies | 150 right, 0 wrong, 106 refused | 256 right, 0 wrong, 0 refused |
| all 352 | 244 right, 0 wrong, 108 refused | 352 right, 0 wrong, 0 refused |

Record sha256 `4529a418c273d6d602813c5f36b11d9993c7f275032cf592a6618524fa11df9b` — sealed in `a1f6c43`.

## Experiment 2 · the creature that watches itself

<!-- ⟦OBSERVE-BEGIN⟧ generated by tools/make-page.mjs — do not edit here -->
**Sealed, not yet run.** the observer's best creature reads U as V by generation 10 in at least 7 of the 8 seeds; the median generation at which the best creature first reads U as V is earlier for the observer than for blind mutation (never found counts as 61); the same median is earlier for the observer than for blind trials with the same compute and self-scoring; the observer's champion is at least as fit on the held-out cards as blind mutation's in at least 7 of the 8 seeds; none of the observer's 8 champions names a wrong card on the held-out reads; re-running all 24 evolutions from this seal gives byte-identical records — CI re-runs them on every push. The result lands here whichever way it goes.
